additional_info.subject: ID0461454-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R2 312555359/025] Failed Authorizations CRM:03208000010
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0461454
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue. The first response has been sent to the customer, and we kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Dream Energy
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / R2 312555359025
Charger ID / Serial No.:
yRk5yL
Charger address/functional location:
Meyreuil,
France
Priority:
Medium
Possible solution: There was an issue with increasing temperature. Currently that doesn´t exist. But need a field visit to check the issue to prevent future incident.
Please measure on-site and confirm the values by measuring directly on the cables coming from the CCS. If you see the same value, then the CCS is faulty and needs replacement. Otherwise, please measure the 1kOhm until you reach the KF13/14.
P1 to P2 and N1 to N2
If you get 1kOhm until the State Monitor, please try replacing the grey connector with a spare one (they have some connectors on the EcoGs that are not used at all)
Or replace the State Monitor
I recommend you to take spare CCS and State Monitor.
Please check any loose connection. Or please swap connection between two those gray connectors.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Harun Ar Rashid
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
Harun Ar Rashid
Technical Support Specialist (eMobility)
Av. 25 de Abril 201, 2845-547, Amora, Portugal.
Email: harun.ar-rashid.ext@siemens.com
